extDesc.message: Clean and fast browser download manager

closeTooltip.description: on the download management page, when the mouse is moved over the button, the text prompt box stops showing

newDownloadPlaceholder.message: Paste a download URL and press Enter

openDownloadFolder.description: open the download folder in Explorer

openSettings.description: open plugin settings in a new tab

openHome.description: Open the browser's default download page in a new tab

deleteConfirmTitle.description: Confirmation title before deleting files from disk

deleteConfirmFileMessage.message: Permanently delete “{}” from disk? This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmFileMessage.description: Confirmation message before deleting one file from disk

deleteConfirmAllMessage.message: Process {} inactive items: delete existing files from disk and clear missing entries? This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmAllMessage.description: Confirmation message before deleting all files from disk

deleteConfirmButton.description: Confirmation button before deleting files from disk

dangerDescription.message: This file may harm your computer
dangerDescription.description: The file may harm your computer

dangerActionRequiredDescription.message: Confirmation required before saving this file

dangerBlockedDescription.message: This download was blocked for security

erase.description: cancel download or clear file from list

openFolderNotification.description: Download completion notification open folder button

leftClickFileSetting.message: Left-click file name to open file

rightClickFileSetting.message: Right-click file name to copy to clipboard

leftClickUrlSetting.message: Left-click URL to open in a new tab

rightClickUrlSetting.message: Right-click URL to copy to clipboard

showDownloadProgressDescSetting.message: Show progress, speed, and remaining time in the popup. Only active downloads visible in the viewport are polled; turn this off to reduce CPU usage during heavy downloads.

deleteFileConfirmSetting.message: Confirm before deleting files from disk

deleteFileConfirmDescSetting.message: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting a single file from disk. When disabled, single files are deleted immediately without undo (“Delete all from disk” always asks for confirmation).

downloadContextMenusDescSetting.message: Add download shortcuts to the browser page context menu and choose which item types to include.

fileRoutingDescription.message: Automatically save downloads into subfolders under your default Downloads directory based on file extension or source domain (off by default). Domain rules take priority over extension rules unless changed.

fileRoutingRuleEnabledLabel.description: Accessible label for the file routing rule toggle

fileRoutingDeleteRule.description: Accessible label for the file routing rule delete button

fileRoutingDeleteRuleConfirm.description: Second confirmation before deleting a file routing rule

downloadNotificationMaxCountDescSetting.message: Dismisses oldest notifications first when the limit is reached. Default: 3; set to 0 for unlimited.

downloadNotificationRemainVisibleDescSet.message: Keep notifications on screen until clicked or dismissed. Supported on Chrome 50+.

pluginSyncDetailsSetting.message: Automatically sync extension settings across Chromium browsers when signed into your browser account.

notSyncSetting.message: This setting is stored locally and not synced

themeAdaptationDescription.message: Automatically match Light or Dark mode across the toolbar icon, download panel, and settings page based on your system appearance.

pageSizeDescription.message: Set the popup panel width (380–800 px) and height (300–600 px).

themeSystemDescription.message: Changes apply immediately. The preview below matches the actual popup panel.

themeSeriesTerminalDescription.message: High-contrast developer aesthetic crafted for a crisp, utility-first look.

themeSeriesTerminalDarkNote.message: Vibrant accents on deep ink with sharp readability.

themeSeriesTerminalLightNote.message: Clean monospace energy in a bright, balanced palette.

themeSeriesGithubDescription.message: Familiar developer workspace style with balanced contrast for everyday productivity.

themeSeriesGithubDarkNote.message: Composed, crisp, and built for focus.

themeSeriesGithubLightNote.message: Clean surfaces with familiar GitHub polish.

themeSeriesClaudeDescription.message: Warm, editorial palette with soft neutral tones for relaxed reading.

themeSeriesClaudeDarkNote.message: Rich espresso warmth with gentle contrast.

themeSeriesClaudeLightNote.message: Soft parchment tones for effortless visual comfort.

themeSeriesBasicDescription.message: Clean and understated default look that blends naturally with any browser theme.

themeSeriesBasicDarkNote.message: Minimal, neutral, and easy on the eyes at night.

themeSeriesBasicLightNote.message: Crisp, clean, and close to native browser UI.

downloadContextMenuContextsDescSetting.message: Choose which right-click targets show download actions (for example, enable Image only if you only want it on images).

cancelAllConfirmMessage.message: Cancel all {} in-progress downloads? Unfinished progress will be discarded.
cancelAllConfirmMessage.description: Confirm message for cancel all active downloads

fileRoutingPrecedenceDescription.message: Choose which rule wins when both a domain rule and an extension rule match. Domain rules take priority by default.

fileRoutingDomainRulesEmpty.message: No domain rules yet. Add one to organize downloads from specific websites into subfolders.

downloadConfirmBeforeStartDescSetting.message: Ask for confirmation before starting downloads triggered by this extension (context menu, new download URL, or retry). Native browser downloads are left untouched to avoid breaking one-time links.

downloadConfirmChooseFolderSetting.message: Ask where to save each download

downloadConfirmChooseFolderDescSetting.message: Open the browser “Save as” dialog for downloads started by this extension. Separate from Chrome/Edge's built-in “Ask where to save each file” setting.

downloadConfirmTitle.description: Confirmation title before starting a download

downloadConfirmMessage.description: Confirmation message before starting a download; {} is the URL

downloadConfirmButton.description: Confirmation button before starting a download

downloadConfirmNotificationTitle.description: Notification title when confirming a context-menu download

downloadConfirmNotificationConfirm.description: Notification button to confirm a pending download

downloadConfirmNotificationCancel.description: Notification button to cancel a pending download

popupHeaderButtonsSetting.description: Toggle optional shortcut buttons in popup header

popupHeaderButtonsDescSetting.message: When turned off, only the search box and Settings button remain visible.

popupHeaderCustomButtonsSetting.description: Choose which buttons appear in the popup header

popupHeaderCustomButtonsDescSetting.message: Click to show or hide a button; drag to reorder (Search and Settings stay pinned).

contextMenuDownloadLink.description: Context menu item to download a link

contextMenuDownloadImage.description: Context menu item to download an image

contextMenuDownloadAudio.description: Context menu item to download audio

contextMenuDownloadVideo.description: Context menu item to download a video

lightThemeTooltip.description: Tooltip for light mode toolbar icon color

darkThemeTooltip.description: Tooltip for dark mode toolbar icon color

copyDownloadUrl.description: Tooltip for copy download link button on file card

showDownloadUrlSetting.description: Toggle download link visibility in popup file cards

showDownloadUrlDescSetting.message: When turned off, cards use a compact two-line layout and automatically show a copy-link button

showCopyUrlButtonSetting.description: Toggle copy-link shortcut button in file card action bar

showCopyUrlButtonDescSetting.message: Adds a quick copy-link action on card hover (always enabled when download links are hidden)
